title: Oxford Is Older Than The Aztec Empire
description:
There is evidence of teaching at the University of Oxford as early as 1096. The Aztec capital Tenochtitlan was founded in 1325 and the Aztec Empire formed in 1428, so Oxford was already more than 300 years old when the empire began, and over 400 years old when it fell in 1521.

Sources: Wikipedia, 'University of Oxford' and 'Tenochtitlan'. The year gaps are our own arithmetic.

What other 'older than' fact surprised you? Tell us in the comments.
